Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

MSP430X only: 20-bit addresses, which a snippet reaches by putting a section
above 64 KiB with `=== name @ addr`, and the address instructions.

Not here: `calla x(rN)` with `x` above 64 KiB. GNU ld keeps the low 16 bits of
its `R_MSP430_ABS16` without a word, where rsasm refuses the value, as GNU ld
itself does for the `R_MSP430X_ABS16` of `mova x(rN), rM`.

=== extended instructions on labels
        .data
        .text
start:  movx.a  #var, r5
        movx.a  &var, r5
        movx.a  var, r5
        movx.a  var(r4), r5
        movx.a  r5, &var
        movx.a  r5, var
        movx.a  r5, var(r6)
        movx.a  &var, &var2
        movx.a  var, var2
        movx.a  var(r4), var2(r5)
        movx    #var, r5
        addx.b  &var, r6
        pushx.a #var
        pushx.a var
        pushx.a &var
        incx    var
        clrx.a  &var
        rlax.a  var
        ret
        .data
        .space  0x10
var:    .word   1
var2:   .word   2

=== extended instructions above 64 KiB @ 0x12340
        .data
        .text
start:  movx.a  #var, r5
        movx.a  &var, r5
        movx.a  var, r5
        movx.a  var(r4), r5
        movx.a  r5, &var
        movx.a  r5, var
        movx.a  var, var2
        movx.a  &var, var2(r5)
        pushx.a #start
        calla   #start
        reta
        .data
        .space  0x10
var:    .word   1
var2:   .word   2

=== address instructions on labels @ 0x1fff0
        .data
        .text
start:  mova    #var, r5
        mova    &var, r5
        mova    var, r5
        mova    r5, &var
        adda    #var, r5
        cmpa    #var, r5
        suba    #var, r5
        bra     #start
        bra     &var
        bra     back
        calla   #start
        calla   &var
        calla   back
back:   reta
        .data
var:    .word   1

=== an index into the low 64 KiB
        .data
        .text
start:  mova    var(r4), r5
        mova    r5, var(r6)
        calla   var(r5)
        reta
        .data
var:    .word   1

=== refused: an index above 64 KiB @ 0x1fff0
        .data
        .text
start:  mova    var(r4), r5
        reta
        .data
var:    .word   1

=== address instructions with numbers
        .text
        calla   #0x12345
        calla   &0x10
        calla   1234(r6)
        mova    #0x12345, r5
        bra     #0x54321
        adda    #0xfffff, r5
        reta

=== the repeat prefix and constant jumps
        .text
        rpt     #4
        rrax    r5
        rpt     r6
        rrcx.a  r7
        jmp     $+4
        jmp     $-2
        jz      4
        nop
        ret

=== polymorphic branches on the MSP430X
        .text
start:  jump    fwd
        beq     start
        bltn    fwd
        bgt     start
        ble     fwd
fwd:    reta
